sourceRecords.title: Ocean Winds Enters Lease Agreement with Crown Estate for 1.5 GW Celtic Sea Floating Wind Project
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that Ocean Winds entered into an agreement for lease with the Crown Estate for a 1.5 GW floating offshore wind project in the Celtic Sea. The source states that the developer will focus on project designs, site surveys, EIA, public engagement and planning consents.
